svg.text: Stewards of the Long Voyage · piece concepts, v3
The machine is gunmetal-grey cast plastic; the people are wood. Threat escalates by silhouette: flat → wheel → tower. Damage is shown by how a piece sits, with no extra parts.
THE MACHINE · threat pieces, one gunmetal plastic
hex nut, lying flat · 10 mm · health 1
cog on its edge, flat-ground foot · 14 mm · health 2
cracked octal tube, flat top cap · 23 mm · health 3
From above too, every piece differs:
DAMAGE STATES · by how the piece sits; all stand up again at Time passes
From above, as players see them on the board:
on its side: the whole tube

Rules: one damage tips a Fault flat; a Failure goes on its side, then upside down, and one more destroys it. Glitch (health 1) has no state. A downgraded piece is replaced standing upright: damage does not carry over.
THE PEOPLE · wood, brass and slag
wooden pawn, fishbowl helmet · 16 mm · health 2
stained wooden rocket nose cones · 10 mm
slag lump, never two the same · 12 mm
ON THE BOARD · mid-turn, on every section colour (pieces at 55 %)
Print-and-play: every piece is a die-cut token with an undamaged face and a damaged face; the Failure's back face is split into its two damaged states (rotate it to show 2 damage).
